mapper.update: MERGE INTO schedule USING DUAL ON (USER_NO = #{userNo} AND SCHDUL_DATE = TO_DATE(#{schdulDate}, 'YYYY/MM/DD')) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET leave = #{leave} , working_time=#{workingTime} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SCHDUL_NO, SCHDUL_DATE, USER_NO, ATTEND) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(schdul_no), 0) + 1 FROM schedule), TO_DATE(#{schdulDate}, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #{userNo}, #{attend} )

update schedule a set a.status=( SELECT CASE WHEN (attend <= '09:00:00' AND leave >= '18:00:00') THEN '정상' WHEN attend > '09:00:00' THEN '지각' WHEN leave < '18:00:00' THEN '조기퇴근' ELSE '기타' END AS status FROM schedule b where a.schdul_no=b.schdul_no ) where user_no=#{userNo}
mapper.select: select count(*) from schedule where USER_NO = #{userNo} AND SCHDUL_DATE=#{schdulDate}
select * from tb_user u left outer join file_group fg on fg.file_group_no = u.user_profile left outer join file_detail fd on fd.file_group_no=fg.file_group_no where user_no=#{userNo}

SELECT nvl(trunc(AVG( TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(s.working_time, 1, 2)) + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(s.working_time, 4, 2)) / 60 ),1),0) AS avgWorkingTime, nvl(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = '정상' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS js, nvl(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = '지각' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS jg, nvl(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = '조기퇴근' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS jgtg FROM schedule s WHERE s.user_no = #{userNo} and to_char(schdul_date,'YYYY-MM')= #{searchDate}
